const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),canvas=$('game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),arena=$('arena');

function newRun(){elapsed=0;spawnTimer=.45;fireTimer=.15;dashTimer=0;dashTime=0;invuln=0;score=0;level=1;xp=0;xpNeed=8;wave=1;kills=0;shake=0;enemies=[];bullets=[];enemyBullets=[];gems=[];particles=[];orbs=[];upgrades={damage:1,rate:1,speed:1,pierce:0,magnet:1,maxHp:100,orbit:0};player={x:W/2,y:H/2,r:8,hp:100,maxHp:100,vx:0,vy:0,aim:0};mode='playing';hideOverlays();updateHud();}
function show(id){$(id).classList.remove('hidden')}function hide(id){$(id).classList.add('hidden')}function hideOverlays(){['startOverlay','pauseOverlay','upgradeOverlay','overOverlay'].forEach(hide)}
$('startBtn').onclick=()=>newRun();$('retryBtn').onclick=()=>newRun();$('resumeBtn').onclick=()=>{mode='playing';hide('pauseOverlay')};$('pauseBtn').onclick=()=>togglePause();
function togglePause(){if(mode==='playing'){mode='paused';show('pauseOverlay')}else if(mode==='paused'){$('resumeBtn').click()}}
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{const k=e.key.toLowerCase();keys[k]=true;if([' ','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright'].includes(k))e.preventDefault();if(k==='escape'||k==='p'){if(mode==='playing'||mode==='paused')togglePause()}if(k===' '&&mode==='playing')dash()});window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false);

function dash(){if(mode!=='playing'||dashTimer>0)return;let dx=(keys.d||keys.arrowright?1:0)-(keys.a||keys.arrowleft?1:0)+joy.x,dy=(keys.s||keys.arrowdown?1:0)-(keys.w||keys.arrowup?1:0)+joy.y;let m=hyp(dx,dy);if(m<.1){dx=Math.cos(player.aim);dy=Math.sin(player.aim);m=1}dx/=m;dy/=m;player.vx=dx*560;player.vy=dy*560;dashTimer=3.1;dashTime=.19;invuln=.32;burst(player.x,player.y,'#5be6d2',14,180)}$('dashTouch').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();dash()});

function spawnEnemy(){const side=Math.floor(rand(0,4));let x=side===0?rand(0,W):side===1?W+15:side===2?rand(0,W):-15,y=side===0?-15:side===1?rand(0,H):side===2?H+15:rand(0,H);let t='chaser',r=7,hp=1,speed=rand(39,53),color='#ff765d';const roll=Math.random();if(elapsed>12&&roll<.20){t='runner';r=5;hp=1;speed=rand(74,92);color='#ffb45c'}else if(elapsed>20&&roll<.36){t='tank';r=12;hp=4+Math.floor(elapsed/80);speed=rand(23,31);color='#c078ff'}else if(elapsed>34&&roll<.49){t='shooter';r=8;hp=2;speed=rand(27,36);color='#ff5a9a'}let boss=elapsed>0&&Math.floor(elapsed/55)>Math.floor((elapsed-.8)/55);if(boss){t='boss';r=21;hp=26+Math.floor(elapsed/10);speed=25;color='#ff3e57'}enemies.push({x,y,r,hp,maxHp:hp,speed,type:t,color,phase:rand(0,7),shot:rand(.8,2),boss});if(boss){wave++;toast('ELITE SIGNAL DETECTED')} }
function fire(){if(!enemies.length)return;let target=null,bd=Infinity;for(const e of enemies){let d=(e.x-player.x)**2+(e.y-player.y)**2;if(d<bd){bd=d;target=e}}if(!target)return;let a=Math.atan2(target.y-player.y,target.x-player.x);player.aim=a;let speed=440;bullets.push({x:player.x+Math.cos(a)*10,y:player.y+Math.sin(a)*10,vx:Math.cos(a)*speed,vy:Math.sin(a)*speed,r:3.2,life:1.15,damage:upgrades.damage,pierce:upgrades.pierce,hit:[]});burst(player.x+Math.cos(a)*9,player.y+Math.sin(a)*9,'#b6fff1',2,45)}
function toast(text){const el=$('toast');el.textContent=text;el.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toast.timer);toast.timer=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'),1050)}

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “2d dot game roglike” in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Build the game now and briefly note assumptions when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone browser game in `index.html` with canvas rendering and no external dependencies.
- Chose a neon sci-fi survivor roguelike: auto-fire, escalating enemy waves, XP pickups, upgrades, dash, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a playable title screen, game arena, HUD, pause/resume, level-up upgrade choices, and game-over/retry flow.
- Added enemy variants, elite encounters, projectiles, XP collection, upgrade effects, particles, and responsive mobile joystick/dash controls.
- JavaScript syntax checked successfully with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright and inspected desktop and mobile JPEG screenshots.

### Active
- Review final changes and summarize the completed work and assumptions to the user.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Check `git status` if needed and provide a concise completion summary, including controls and the assumption that “roglike” meant roguelike survivor gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Contains the complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
